description:
A desktop terminal for running multiple CLI agents in parallel sessions.

PATerminal provides parallel terminal sessions, split panes, session resume,
agent status, and Git tools for CLI agent workflows on Windows and macOS.
CLI agents must be installed and authenticated separately.
Official builds include a 30-day trial of all features. Advanced features
require a license after the trial. The source is available under a proprietary license.
Changes
- Group color. Right-clicking a group header in the sidebar shows a "Group color" picker with the same six theme colors as the session background, plus "none". The color tints the header and its arrow, and draws a matching line down the left of the group's members so the group's extent is visible at a glance. It is saved with the session.
- Drop files from Finder / Explorer into the folder browser. Dropping files or folders onto the folder browser copies them into the shown folder, or into a folder row / place / favorite you drop onto. The target is outlined while dragging, the list reloads with the first copied item selected, and a notice reports the result. Name collisions copy nothing and show an error (nothing is overwritten). Outside the browser, drops still type paths into panes.
- The folder browser no longer closes on window blur, so you can click Finder to start a drag. Outside click, Esc and window resize still close it.
macOS Universal and Windows x64 installers are attached by the release workflow. This release becomes Latest after the build and updater signature checks succeed.
